🧳 The trader lowers their voice. "And further still — FOUR fires under one head. They call it a REALM. Tribute flows uphill like a river; I saw the grain carts with my own eyes." They won't say more. Or can't.
Village meal: +1000 kcal, +1L water from the communal pantry. (Half ration — they don't trust you yet.)
🍽️ Smita takes one look at the full shelves and unshoulders the pack. "Leave the wild standing. Hauling water for the cistern."
The first night of Winter. A day ends at the fire; a season ends there too, only longer. The village sits up late.
Behind us: Autumn. Harvest season. Nuts, persimmons, last greens. Fatten up. The Codex grew this season — 40 new: Wild Ginger, Blackberry, Elderberry (+37 more).
